name: OpenVPN Server
description: OpenVPN server add-on for Home Assistant OS

public_endpoint.name: Public address or domain
public_endpoint.description: The address your devices connect to, for example vpn.example.com. Written into exported client profiles.

listen_port.name: Local listening port
listen_port.description: The port OpenVPN binds on this host. Usually 1194.

public_port.name: Client connection port
public_port.description: The port written into client profiles. If your router forwards external 9999 to local 1194, put 9999 here.

protocol.name: Transport protocol
protocol.description: UDP is faster and is the recommended default. Choose TCP only if your network blocks UDP.

lan_networks.name: Home LAN networks
lan_networks.description: Subnets VPN clients should reach, comma separated, for example 192.168.1.0/24.

nat_enabled.name: Enable LAN forwarding (NAT)
nat_enabled.description: Required for clients to reach devices on your LAN. With this off, clients can only reach the VPN server itself.

redirect_gateway.name: Route all client traffic through the VPN
redirect_gateway.description: When on, client internet traffic also goes through this VPN.

vpn_subnet.name: VPN network
vpn_subnet.description: Private address range handed to VPN clients. Keep the default unless it clashes with your LAN.

vpn_netmask.name: VPN netmask
vpn_netmask.description: Netmask for the VPN network, for example 255.255.255.0.

dns.name: DNS pushed to clients
dns.description: Comma separated DNS servers sent to VPN clients, for example 223.5.5.5, 119.29.29.29.

device.name: TUN device
device.description: Keep 'tun'. Only change it for bridged setups.

cipher.name: Data cipher
cipher.description: Preferred data channel cipher. AES-256-GCM is the modern default.

auth.name: Auth digest
auth.description: HMAC digest for the control channel. SHA256 is recommended.

tls_crypt.name: Use tls-crypt
tls_crypt.description: Encrypts and authenticates the control channel and hides the VPN from port scanners. Keep it on.

client_to_client.name: Allow clients to reach each other

duplicate_cn.name: Share one certificate between devices
duplicate_cn.description: Off (recommended): one certificate per device, and each client gets a fixed VPN address. On: devices can share a single profile, but revoking that certificate logs out all of them and fixed addresses are disabled.

fixed_client_ips.name: Assign fixed VPN addresses
fixed_client_ips.description: Gives every client a stable VPN address, which makes router and firewall rules predictable. Only applies when certificates are not shared.

publish_profiles_to_share.name: Also copy client profiles to /share
publish_profiles_to_share.description: Off by default. The exported .ovpn contains the client private key and /share is readable by other add-ons; download profiles from the add-on panel instead.

crl_valid_days.name: Revocation list validity (days)
crl_valid_days.description: How long the certificate revocation list stays valid. It is rebuilt at add-on startup, so keep this comfortably longer than your typical uptime.

server_host.name: Local bind address
server_host.description: Address OpenVPN listens on inside the container. 0.0.0.0 is correct unless you have a specific reason.

extra_routes.name: Extra pushed routes
extra_routes.description: Additional subnets pushed to clients, comma separated, for example 10.0.0.0/24.

log_level.name: Log level
log_level.description: Higher levels log more detail into the add-on log.

status_interval.name: Status refresh interval (seconds)
status_interval.description: How often the online client list is written.

client_name.name: Default client name
client_name.description: Certificate created and re-exported automatically at startup.

client_expire_days.name: Client certificate validity (days)
client_expire_days.description: How long newly issued client certificates stay valid.
